gloss_en: The paired Kabbalistic term 'Yichuda Ila'ah and Yichuda Tata'ah' — the Supernal Unification and the Lower Unification, the two divine unifications enacted respectively by 'Shema Yisrael' and 'Baruch Shem Kevod Malchuto' (Zohar Bereishit 18b), corresponding in Likutey Moharan I:11 to the two aspects of guarding the covenant (shemirat ha-brit)
